text:
Tuesday is up on the Mac mini. Fresh install confirmed — it is not a Time Machine restore, so the whole bring-up run-sheet applies.

Done already, no password needed: Superwhisper, iTerm2, VS Code, Chrome and Docker Desktop are installed in Applications. Every one had its Apple notarisation checked before it was copied, not after.

I need you to do one thing, and it unblocks everything else. Open Terminal and paste this:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

That is the Homebrew installer and it is the only step that needs your password. An agent shell has no terminal for the prompt, which is why it has to be your hands.

Once it finishes, tell me and I will install node, gh, azure-cli, tmux, unison, pandoc, poppler, ffmpeg, python 3.14 and uv without asking again.

The reason it matters: without tmux I cannot open agent panes, and without gh and azure-cli I cannot see the Datasec boards or tenants. Right now I can read Linear and mail and nothing else.

Sweep is done and my half is installed. Here is what is left, and only the first needs you right now.

One. Paste the Homebrew line into Terminal. It is on the panel above. That is the only password step and it unblocks eleven command line tools.

Two, after that, four things that are yours because they are GUI or need a password: launch Docker once and accept its prompts, install Tailscale, add the Matilda Premium voice in Spoken Content, and double click install underscore credentials dot command in Setup and System so I get your GitHub and Azure logins.

Three, and this is the one I actually need a decision on rather than a click. I hold Linear and Agent Mail and nothing else. I do not have Jira credentials, so I cannot see the NexusAI board — which is the main Datasec board and therefore most of my job. Wednesday's note says moving a client's credentials into my seat is your call and you had not made it. Do you want me to have them?

Everything else can wait. One thing you should know: WED forty-eight, the CypherKey Twilio token rotation, has been overdue since the fourth. That is Datasec, so it is mine, and I will pick it up once I can see a board.

Here is the command again. Open Terminal and paste this one line:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

It will ask for your Mac password, then run for a couple of minutes. Tell me when it is done and I will take it from there.
